summary: Created an XFS logical volume at /srv/data, grew it online from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB without unmounting or changing file contents, configured reboot persistence, and verified recovery after restarting node1. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created two persistent file-backed LVM physical volumes, volume group vg_data, and logical volume lv_data.
Mounted the XFS filesystem at /srv/data and created preservation test data.
Extended lv_data online from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB and grew XFS while mount ID 379 remained unchanged.
Configured early-boot loop attachment and a UUID-based persistent /etc/fstab mount.
Restarted node1 and verified its new boot identity, recovered LVM state, mounted filesystem, preserved data, and post-restart write access.

evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
evidence.summary: Shows vg_data/lv_data created at 1.00 GiB, formatted as XFS, active, and mounted at /srv/data.

evidence.requirement: Grow the logical volume to at least 2 GB while mounted and preserve contents
evidence.summary: The pre-growth baseline records mount ID 379, a 1.00 GiB LV, and file hashes. The growth command extends it to 2.25 GiB, grows XFS to 2.2 GiB, retains mount ID 379, and reproduces both hashes exactly.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart output both show RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

evidence.requirement: Persist the logical volume and mount across boot
evidence.summary: Shows enabled boot-time loop setup, UUID-based fstab configuration, and successful post-restart recovery of both PVs, the active 2.25 GiB LV, and the mounted 2.2 GiB XFS filesystem.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 4864a932-d2d5-48a3-8a29-6d127e972a6c; final proof confirms service, loop devices, LVM, mount, hashes, original content, and post-restart writes all recovered.
